exposure: Significant fibrosis vs. no significant fibrosis
cohort: 21,875 patients in primary health care units in Poland
finding: The prevalence of HCV infections in Poland was estimated at 0.47%, with significant fibrosis present in 0.12%, and risk factors varied by sex and fibrosis stage.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections in women were a strong predictor of significant liver fibrosis related to HCV infection.
